name: Aiwa Uruguay
description: Official Uruguayan online store of the Aiwa brand, built on the Fenicio platform. Sells audio and TV products and air conditioners. States that it ships across Uruguay; delivery times and shipping costs are not given on the homepage.
description_es: Tienda online oficial de la marca Aiwa en Uruguay, desarrollada sobre la plataforma Fenicio. Vende productos de audio y TV y aires acondicionados. Indica que envía a todo el país; los plazos y costos de envío no figuran en la página principal.

ships_to.notes: Homepage banner says shipping covers the whole country. Cost and time not stated.

fulfillment.pickup_notes: Lists a store in Maldonado and a store page; pickup availability is not stated.

endpoints.notes: Plain-text llms.txt published by the store for AI assistants.

sources.supports: nationwide shipping banner, store address, brand and platform
